'''Yassia Koth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] of the [[Interplanetary Component Exchange]] stationed on the [[Vaiken Spacedock]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yassia Koth appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a vendor.
